prompt: Create an original 90 second contemporary organ music instrumental composition for puzzle game, strategy and patient problem solving. Mood: curious, playful, precise. Instruments: pipe organ, low strings. Style: slow pedal tones and open suspended harmony. Tempo approximately 60 BPM; C lydian. Main idea: a compact three-note motif. Use offset accents and question-and-answer motifs without dramatic shocks. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:30] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:30-01:00] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [01:00-01:30] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:30.

description.en: An elegant and whimsical orchestral piece with a waltz-like feel, featuring prominent strings and woodwinds. It evokes a classical or fairytale atmosphere, with a flowing and graceful melody.
description.zh: 一首优雅而异想天开的管弦乐曲，带有华尔兹般的韵律，以突出的弦乐和木管乐器为特色。它营造出古典或童话般的氛围，旋律流畅而优美。
